references.text: The Israelites broke camp from Rameses and traveled to Succoth. This is the first mention of Succoth as a stopping place during the Exodus from Egypt.
Here the arrival of the Israelites at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness, is described, which corresponds directly with Num 33:6.
The previous verse in the itinerary describes the departure from Rameses to Succoth, the place they left in verse 6.
The next stop in the itinerary after Etham, where the Israelites turned back toward Pi Hahiroth.
